environmentVariables.description: Named profile from ~/.aws/config to use. Leave unset to use the default profile.

environmentVariables.description: Default AWS region if not set elsewhere.

environmentVariables.description: Static AWS access key. Only needed if not using a profile/SSO/role.
environmentVariables.name: AWS_ACCESS_KEY_ID

environmentVariables.description: Temporary session token, if using short-lived credentials.
environmentVariables.name: AWS_SESSION_TOKEN
